CAVEAT: peak_rss_gb uses /proc/self/status VmHWM, which is a monotonic non-decreasing per-PROCESS high-water mark, not a per-design reset measurement. Because all 3 designs ran sequentially in one process (to share Julia's compilation cache and keep the gate fast), rows 6-7's peak_rss_gb figures are cumulative across all designs run so far in that process, not that design's own isolated peak. Timing figures (t_ctx_build_s etc.) ARE per-design and independent. A fully isolated per-design memory measurement would need one fresh process per design; not done in this session given time budget -- the true single-context peak for ANY one design at W=500,000 is bounded above by the halton row's 20.32GB and bounded below by the pseudorandom row's 10.82GB (the first, and therefore cleanest, individual measurement).
